results.original_prompt:
This is a hollow rectangular block (a rectangular frame) with a large recessed rounded rectangular pocket on one face, four small filleted corner bosses added to the pocket corners, and four small through holes near the four outer corners.

Setup: the main body is sketched on the XY workplane at origin (-100, -48, -30). Additional sketches use the listed workplane origins: (-96, -36, 30), (-36, 13, -25), (-36, -17, -25), (32, -17, -25), (32, 17, -25), (-96, 42, 30), (92, 42, 30), (92, -42, 30), and (-96, -42, 30).

Build description:
- On the XY plane at (-100, -48, -30) sketch an outer rectangle by its corner points (0,0), (200,0), (200,95), (0,95) and subtract a concentric inner rectangle defined by corners (64,31) and (136,65) to create a rectangular frame outline. Extrude that outline 60 in the positive normal direction to form the main hollow block.
- On the XY plane at (-96, -36, 30) sketch a large rounded outer profile that follows these connected edges: arc from (0,0) to (8,-8) via (7,-1); straight to (185,-8); arc to (193,0) via (186,-1); straight to (193,72); arc to (185,80) via (186,74); straight to (8,80); arc to (0,72) via (7,74); back to (0,0). From that profile subtract the inner rectangle with corners (60,19) and (132,53). Finalize that sketch and extrude it 55 in the negative normal direction to cut the recessed rounded pocket into the block.
- Add four small filleted corner boss pieces by sketching and extruding 12 in the positive normal direction on the following XY workplanes and local sketches (coordinates are in each workplane’s local XY):
  - At (-36, 13, -25): polygonal corner defined (0,0) → (0,4) → (4,4) then an arc from (4,4) back to (0,0) (arc control (-3,6)).
  - At (-36, -17, -25): polygon (0,0) → (4,0) then an arc from (4,0) to (0,4) (arc control (-3,-3)) and close to (0,0).
  - At (32, -17, -25): arc from (0,0) to (4,4) (arc control (6,-3)), then segments (4,4) → (4,0) → (0,0).
  - At (32, 17, -25): segments (0,0) → (4,0) → (4,-4) then an arc from (4,-4) back to (0,0) (arc control (6,3)).
  Each of those sketches is extruded 12 in the positive normal and unioned to the main body.
- Cut four small circular holes by sketching on the XY planes at (-96, 42, 30), (92, 42, 30), (92, -42, 30), and (-96, -42, 30). In each workplane push the sketch origin by (2,0), draw a circle of radius 2, finalize and extrude that circle 12 in the negative normal direction to remove material (these are the through holes).
